title: Cosmic Egg Nebula
description: A glowing cosmic orb resembling a planet or nebula floats at the center, displaying swirling clouds of turquoise, deep blue, purple and pink with a bright central star. A thick black stylized line loops around the orb in an abstract, calligraphic manner against a soft purple and blue swirling background with small star-like dots.
prompt: A surreal cosmic orb floating in space, glowing with swirling turquoise, cyan, deep blue, purple and pink nebulae clouds and a bright central star. A thick expressive black line loops around the orb in elegant abstract curves. Soft purple and blue swirling background with scattered small glowing dots, dreamy ethereal atmosphere, painterly style.
